Subject: Locked briefcase: Eval kit exchange & MAP request

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed on the call, we want to proceed with a short evaluation of Redwood for our product search assistant. To make the pilot useful we need a mutual action plan (MAP) that covers the transfer of: a) a small evaluation dataset (~15k conversational testcases), b) two prompt packs (behavioral + safety), and c) a set of signed test-cases for acceptance.

A few constraints from our side:
- Limited-use: data is for evaluation only, may not be used to train models or redistributed.
- Ephemeral access: sandbox access for 45 days, after which materials must be destroyed and a certificate of deletion provided.
- Scoped personnel: only the pilot engineering & QA teams (names provided separately) may access testcases.
- No production logging of raw prompts or responses for model-building.

We have an existing NDA on file (signed March 2026). Can you send a MAP draft and an inventory template we can use to confirm what you'll need? Our target: execution and transfer by 2026-06-12 so the pilot can start the week of 2026-06-15.

Also: please flag anything from your side that requires legal signoff.

Thanks —
Sara
Sara Park
Director, Applied ML
Olive Tech

Subject: Re: Locked briefcase: Eval kit exchange & MAP request

Sara —

Appreciate the clear constraints and timeline. We can support the 45‑day ephemeral sandbox and the limited-use covenant, but we have a few operational guardrails to propose so both sides are aligned before transfer:

High-level MAP items we propose (I attached a starter draft):
- Inventory & minimal metadata (file-level provenance, hash, subset tags) — attachment: eval-kit-inventory-olivetech.csv
- Scoped access policy (RBAC for named users, audit logs retained in redwood private console but not exported)
- Acceptance tests: 200 weighted testcases (subset of the 15k) to run against our serving baseline; acceptance metric is F1 on intent extraction + qualitative pass/fail on hallucination criteria
- Ephemeral lifecycle: sandbox provisioning window + destruction certificates
- Escrow for sensitive seed cases: a sealed transfer (“locked briefcase”) where we hold a time-locked archive and provide signed proof of destruction after expiry

Two asks from our side:
1) A brief inventory of the data sensitivity tiers (PII / PHI / internal-only) so we can set retention and redaction defaults.
2) Confirmation that Olive Tech engineering will not attempt to reconstitute hidden prompt tokens from logs.

Next steps I suggest:
- I’ll circulate a first MAP draft and inventory template by Monday.
- Karthik & Laura from Ops/Legal will review constraints and call out any items requiring enterprise legal signoff.

Can you confirm target signature date (we have 2026-06-10 tentatively blocked on our calendar)?

Cheers,
Vivek
Head of Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: locked-briefcase-MAP-v0.1.pdf; eval-kit-inventory-olivetech.csv
